declarations.name: subsystems.CAMERA_LANE_TERM
declarations.basis: Xilinx XAPP894 '7-series + external passives' D-PHY topology: an HR bank cannot switch DIFF_TERM, so each CSI-2 pair carries a fixed external 100 ohm differential termination at the receiver end of the trace.

declarations.name: subsystems.CAMERA_I2C_PULL
declarations.basis: MIPI CCI / I2C Rp on the gated +VDD_CAM rail. NXP UM10204 eq 2 gives Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 * Cb); at Fast-mode 400 kHz (tr 300 ns) 4k7 holds for Cb <= 75 pF, which the short FFC control pair meets. House value shared with the lcd touch bus; the bus is dead without it (open drain).

declarations.name: subsystems.CAMERA_RAIL_BYPASS
declarations.basis: HF bypass at the FFC power pin (J1.15) on the gated camera rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.CAMERA_RAIL_BULK
declarations.basis: Local bulk at the FFC for the RPi V2/IMX219 ~250 mA module budget; the peer FFC subsystems (lcd, microsd) carry the same 10u at the connector.

declarations.name: subsystems.ETHERNET_BOB_SMITH_R
declarations.basis: IEEE 802.3 section 40.7.1 Bob-Smith HF termination: each MEDIA centre tap sees 75 ohm (half the 150 ohm common-mode impedance of a UTP pair) into the shared trunk. LCSC C4275.

declarations.name: subsystems.ETHERNET_BOB_SMITH_C
declarations.basis: Bob-Smith trunk cap and the single BS_COMMON -> CHASSIS_GND isolation element. GENUINE 1 nF / 2 kV X7R (IEC 60950/62368 hi-pot), 1206 body for the 2 kV rating; LCSC C9196 (FH 1206B102K202NT), JLC Basic.

declarations.name: subsystems.ETHERNET_CENTRE_TAP_C
declarations.basis: Realtek RTL8211E/EG Layout Guide Rev 1.0 (Track ID JATR-2265-11) section 7 Center-Tapping, p.19, Fig. 27: short transformer centre-tap pins 1, 4, 7 and 10 and connect to GND through a 0.1 uF-10 pF capacitor to improve EMI. Applied to the RTL8211F on the module by family inference; the RTL8211F layout guide was not obtained. One capacitor on the shorted PHY-side centre taps to logic GND (not CHASSIS_GND), LCSC C14663 0603 X7R 50 V.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_RX_HPD_ASSERT
declarations.basis: HDMI 1.4 section 4.2.6 passive hot-plug assert: the cable's own +5V (pin 18) is returned to HPD (pin 19) through 1 kohm, so a plugged source sees HPD high and reads EDID with the consuming board unpowered.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_RX_CEC_PULL
declarations.basis: HDMI 1.4 CEC Supplement 1: the CEC line carries a 27 kohm pull-up to the device's 3.3 V supply. Here the gated module rail +VDD_LOGIC.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_RX_DET_TOP
declarations.basis: Cable-5V presence divider, top leg. With the 15k bottom leg the worst-case cable rail 5.25 V presents 5.25*15/25 = 3.15 V at HDMI_5V_DET — inside LVCMOS33 abs-max, so the detect line is safe on a 3.3 V bank.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_RX_DET_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: Cable-5V presence divider, bottom leg; the 10k/15k ratio sets the 3.15 V worst-case output (see HDMI_RX_DET_TOP).

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_RX_EDID_BYPASS
declarations.basis: M24C02 EDID EEPROM VCC bypass on the cable-5V quasi-rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_TX_RAIL_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TI TPD12S016 SLLSE96F Figure 15: 100 nF on V_CCA (pin 24) and on V_CC5V (pin 11).

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_TX_RAIL_BULK
declarations.basis: Module bulk on the +VDD_IO controller rail; the peer connector subsystems (camera, microsd) carry the same 10u per module rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_TX_CABLE_BYPASS
declarations.basis: HDMI 1.4 section 4.2.7: HF decoupling on the source's switched +5V at the receptacle (pin 18).

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_TX_CABLE_BULK
declarations.basis: HDMI 1.4 section 4.2.7 bulk companion to the 100 nF at the receptacle +5V pin.

declarations.name: subsystems.HDMI_TX_STRAP_PULL
declarations.basis: TI TPD12S016 SLLSE96F Figure 15 / section 8.2.1 'HDMI source using one GPIO': LS_OE (pin 5) and CT_HPD (pin 12) strapped HIGH through 10 kohm to V_CCA so the level shifters and the 55 mA +5V switch are always on.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_ISET_SENSE
declarations.basis: Silergy SY7201 WLED-boost current set: I_LED = V_FB / R_ISET with V_FB = 0.2 V, so 0.2/1.5 = 133 mA into the LED string.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_BOOST_INDUCTOR
declarations.basis: SY7201 application inductor (SWPA4030S100MT, 10 uH).

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_BOOST_CIN
declarations.basis: SY7201 boost input bulk per the application circuit (10u + 1u at IN).

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_BOOST_HF
declarations.basis: SY7201 dedicated HF ceramic at the IN pin; the application circuit specifies 10u + 1u and only the 10u was fitted (audit 2026-06-20).

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_BOOST_COUT
declarations.basis: SY7201 boost output cap on LCD_VLED_P, 50 V X7R (LCSC C125847). The node resolves to the 30 V open-LED OVP clamp; continuous string voltage is ~9.6 V, so the 50 V part carries the rare fault transient with the 2x MLCC derate applied to the continuous bias (LCD-1).

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_PANEL_BYPASS
declarations.basis: Panel VDD HF bypass at the FFC on the gated +VDD_LCD rail (lcd_backlight.md 3.1: '10uF + 100n').

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_PANEL_BULK
declarations.basis: Panel VDD bulk (lcd_backlight.md 3.1: '10uF + 100n'); only the 100n was present, the peers camera/microsd carry 10u.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_TOUCH_PULL
declarations.basis: Capacitive-touch I2C Rp to the gated +VDD_LCD. NXP UM10204 eq 2 gives Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 * Cb); at Fast-mode 400 kHz (tr 300 ns) 4k7 holds for Cb <= 75 pF. Open-drain bus: without these the bus is dead.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_RESET_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: Touch-controller reset held asserted until the host releases it — a driven reset, not an RC reset, so no cap-to-GND by design.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_DISP_PULLUP
declarations.basis: Panel display-enable defaults ON whenever the gated rail is up.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_PCLK_DAMPING
declarations.basis: Source-series damping on the ~33 MHz pixel clock, the highest-edge-rate line on the FFC; the resistor sits at the host/source end so the series sum approaches the ~50 ohm trace impedance.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_BLPWM_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: SY7201 EN/PWM held low so the backlight boost is OFF until the host drives it high.

declarations.name: subsystems.LCD_TOUCH_CLAMP_BYPASS
declarations.basis: ST USBLC6-2 datasheet Rev 2 (June 2005), section 3 'How to ensure a good ESD protection', figure 7: a 100 nF capacitor close to the device between VBUS (pin 5) and ground holds the clamp reference constant during a positive surge. 0603 50 V X7R, LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_CARD_PULL
declarations.basis: TI SCEA054A: the TXS02612 B0 one-shot outputs already hold an internal pull-up (4 kohm high / 40 kohm low, fig.1). An external pull parallels the internal 40 kohm while driving low — Table 1 measures VOL 29 mV (no pull) -> 169 mV (~10k) -> 38 mV (100k), guidance '>50 kohm beneficial'. 100k keeps an SD-spec anti-float pull inside that band. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_DETECT_PULL
declarations.basis: Card-detect pull-up. NOT on a TXS02612 output, so the SCEA054A >50 kohm rule does not apply and the plain 10k anti-float value stands.

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_HOST_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TXS02612 VCCA (host-side) local bypass.

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_CARD_BYPASS
declarations.basis: Card-rail HF bypass (VCCB0/VCCB1 + slot VDD).

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_CARD_BULK
declarations.basis: Card-rail bulk sized for SD write bursts: the SD physical spec allows ~200 mA on the card supply, and the budgeted draw is 250 mA.

declarations.name: subsystems.MICROSD_ESD_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TI SLLS546: the TPD6E001 VCC sets the clamp reference; a floating VCC gives the worst-case clamp, so VCC is biased to the card rail and bypassed locally (SD-1).

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_INLET_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TPS26631 datasheet-minimum input capacitance at the raw receptacle VBUS, alongside the SMBJ22A TVS.

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_OVP_TOP
declarations.basis: TPS26631 OVP divider, top leg from +VBUS_CONN. With the 5.49k bottom leg the OVP trip is 23.06 V typ — above the 21 V worst-case 20 V PD contract and below the downstream 24 V-class limits (PD-1 widened the window).

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_OVP_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: TPS26631 OVP divider, bottom leg; the 100k/5.49k ratio sets the 23.06 V typ trip (PD-1). LCSC C188263.

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_ILIM_SET
declarations.basis: TPS26631 current limit: I_OL = 18 / R_ILIM(kohm) = 18/5.1 = 3.5 A, above the 3 A PD contract with margin.

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_DVDT_CAP
declarations.basis: TPS26631 dVdT soft-start cap; 47 nF sets a 1.02 V/ms output slew, so the downstream bulk charges without tripping the current limit.

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_FAULT_PULL
declarations.basis: Open-drain FLT# pull-up to the always-on +VDD_LOGIC (never the 20 V inlet VBUS — an expander IO abs-max is far below the PD contract).

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_FUSED_BULK
declarations.basis: The dVdT-charged board bulk behind the eFuse; 1210 50 V X7R (LCSC C596319) for the 21 V worst-case rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.PD_INPUT_CLAMP_BYPASS
declarations.basis: ST USBLC6-2 datasheet Rev 2 (June 2005), section 3 'How to ensure a good ESD protection', figure 7: a 100 nF capacitor close to the device between VBUS (pin 5) and ground holds the clamp reference constant during a positive surge. 0603 50 V X7R, LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_SERIES_DAMPING
declarations.basis: Digilent Pmod specification: each host IO carries a 200 ohm series protection resistor between the host signal and the socket pin. LCSC C8218.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_RAIL_BYPASS
declarations.basis: Per-port HF bypass at the Pmod VCC pins (positions 6/12).

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_RAIL_BULK
declarations.basis: Per-port bulk for the Digilent ~100 mA per-module budget.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_ILIM_SET
declarations.basis: Silergy SY6280 current limit: I_LIM = 6800 / R_ISET(kohm) = 6800/13 = 523 mA, above the Digilent ~100 mA per-module budget with margin. LCSC C22797.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_INPUT_BYPASS
declarations.basis: HF bypass at the SY6280 IN pin, ahead of the 10u input bulk.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_INPUT_BULK
declarations.basis: SY6280 datasheet Pin Description ('IN ... decoupled with a 10uF capacitor to GND') and Application Information ('a 10uF ceramic capacitor from VIN to GND is strongly recommended'): without it an output short rings the input, and the rail bulk sits upstream of the inlet shunt.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_OUTPUT_BYPASS
declarations.basis: SY6280 OUT-pin HF bypass; the datasheet 10u OUT bulk is met by the socket bulk on the same +VSW_PMOD net.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_ENABLE_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: Holds SY6280 EN low so the port is dark at power-up until the DSHP04 switch is closed by hand — a peripheral cannot be back-fed.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_LED_SERIES
declarations.basis: Status LED on the gated 3.3 V output: (3.3 - 2.0)/330 = 3.9 mA through the KT-0603R red LED.

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_SOCKET_BYPASS
declarations.basis: HF bypass at the Pmod VCC pins (positions 6/12).

declarations.name: subsystems.PMOD_EXP_SOCKET_BULK
declarations.basis: Socket bulk for the Digilent ~100 mA module budget; also serves as the SY6280 OUT bulk (same net).

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_VIN_HF
declarations.basis: TI SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.5 requires a 100 nF at EACH VIN/PGND pin pair immediately adjacent to the LM61460, rated 50 V with X7R or better. LCSC C14663 (CC0603KRX7R9BB104, 100 nF 50 V X7R) meets the rule; the VQFN-HR splits VIN/PGND across opposite package sides so one goes at each.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_VIN_BULK
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.5 '>=10 uF ceramic at the input'; 2x 1206 50 V-class for the 21 V +VIN rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_5V_BULK
declarations.basis: Input bulk for the +3V3 buck off the board +5V rail (SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.5); 0805 25 V-class, 2 pieces.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_VCC_BYPASS
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.8: 1 uF from VCC (pin 2) to AGND, the internal-LDO bypass, 16 V ceramic.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_BIAS_SERIES
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.9: 'a series resistor, 1 ohm to 10 ohm, can be added between VOUT and BIAS'. Top of the band for maximum noise filtering; the BIAS LDO sink current is small so the IR drop is negligible. LCSC C22859.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_BIAS_BYPASS
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.9: 'a bypass capacitor of 1 uF or higher can be added close to the BIAS pin'.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_RT_FREQ
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D Eq 2: R_RT(kohm) = (1/fSW(kHz) - 3.3e-5) * 1.346e4, so 600 kHz gives 21.99k ~= 22.0k. 600 kHz keeps the existing 10 uH SWPA8040S within its 4 A Isat on both stages. LCSC C31850.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_BOOT_CAP
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.6: 100 nF SW->CBOOT, X7R >=10 V. 9.2.2.7 allows RBOOT shorted to CBOOT, so pins 13/14 are one node and no boot resistor exists.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_SW_INDUCTOR
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.3 Eq 11 minimum at D<50% is L >= 0.2*Vout/fSW = 0.2*5/600k = 1.67 uH; 10 uH is well above it so the loop is stable with no subharmonic oscillation. Ripple dIL = 0.63 A p-p at 5 V (Ipk 3.27 A) and 0.187 A p-p at 3.3 V (Ipk 2.84 A), both under the 4 A Isat of the SWPA8040S (LCSC C37429).

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_COUT_BULK
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D Table 9-5 (5 V application BOM) and Table 9-3 both list 3x 22 uF COUT at 5 V; 9.2.2.3 notes a larger-than-minimum inductor needs MORE output capacitance for transients, which the 10 uH choice makes the dominant term. 25 V Basic 0805, LCSC C45783.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_FB5V_TOP
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 8.3.11 Vref = 1.0 V, Vout = 1.0*(1 + Rtop/Rbot): 40.2k/10k -> 5.02 V. LCSC C12447 (UNI-ROYAL 0603WAF4022T5E, 40.2k 0603 1%). BOM-CRITICAL: the prior C25750 was a mis-key resolving to a 120k 0402, which would set ~13.1 V on the +5V rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_FB3V3_TOP
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 8.3.11 Vref = 1.0 V: 23.2k/10k -> 3.32 V, worst case ~[3.24, 3.40], centred in the +-3% window [3.201, 3.399]. Replaced 22.1k, whose 3.21 V nominal left only ~3.13 V against the 3.135 V floor. LCSC C23346.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_FB_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: Common FB-divider bottom leg for both LM61460 stages; the ratio against the per-stage top leg sets Vout (SNVSBD5D 8.3.11). LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_CFF_CAP
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.10 feedforward across the FB-top resistor for phase margin with low-ESR ceramic COUT. Tables 9-2 and 9-5 both list CFF = 22 pF at 5 V. The ESR zero of a ceramic COUT is well above the 200 kHz no-CFF threshold, and both Vout are below the 14 V no-CFF ceiling.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_RFF_SERIES
declarations.basis: SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.10: 'a 1-kohm resistor, RFF, can be placed in series with CFF' because CFF conducts output noise straight to FB. Table 9-2 5 V row lists RFF = 1 kohm.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_LED5V_SERIES
declarations.basis: Rail-up indicator on the 5 V regulator-side node: (5.0 - 2.0)/1000 = 3.0 mA through the red LED.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_LED_SERIES
declarations.basis: Rail-up indicator on the 3.3 V-class nodes: (3.3 - 2.0)/330 = 3.9 mA through the red LED.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_LDO_CAP
declarations.basis: AP2112K input and output capacitance: the datasheet requires >=1 uF on both, and the LDO is stable with a 1 uF ceramic output cap.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_GATE_STOP
declarations.basis: AO3400A gate-stop for the +1V8 PG sense cell. PWR-6: with the 100k pulldown a 10k series made Vgs = 1.8*100/110 = 1.64 V, barely over the 1.45 V max Vgs(th); 1k gives 1.8*100/101 = 1.78 V and is a pure RC gate-stop rather than a divider.

declarations.name: subsystems.POWER_GATE_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: AO3400A gate pulldown holding the +1V8 sense FET off until the rail is up; sets the divider ratio in PWR-6 above.

declarations.name: subsystems.RJ45_LED_SERIES
declarations.basis: The two LEDs integrated in the KH-5224 housing driven as a steady port-present indicator off the always-on +VLED: (3.3 - 2.0)/330 = 4 mA each. LCSC C23138.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_BRIDGE_SUPPLY_BYPASS
declarations.basis: SiLabs CP2102N self-powered reference: 100 nF on each of VREGIN (pin 7), VDD (pin 6) and VIO (pin 5).

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_BRIDGE_VREGIN_BULK
declarations.basis: CP2102N self-powered reference bulk on VREGIN alongside the 100 nF.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_BRIDGE_RESET_PULL
declarations.basis: CP2102N ~RST is open-drain and needs an external pull to VDD33; the part carries its own internal POR so no RC cap is fitted.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_BRIDGE_SENSE_TOP
declarations.basis: CP2102N self-powered VBUS-sense divider, top leg from the UART receptacle's own 5 V VBUS. With the 47k5 bottom leg the pin sees 5*47.5/69.6 = 3.41 V, inside the 5.8 V abs-max. LCSC C25961.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_BRIDGE_SENSE_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: CP2102N VBUS-sense divider, bottom leg (see UART_BRIDGE_SENSE_TOP). LCSC C23061.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_LDO_CIN
declarations.basis: AP2112K input capacitance for the self-powered island LDO (datasheet minimum 1 uF).

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_LDO_COUT
declarations.basis: AP2112K output bulk; the datasheet minimum is 1 uF and 10 uF carries the CH347 + buffer + pull network on the island rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_SUPPLY_BYPASS
declarations.basis: CH347 datasheet section 5.1 (~0.1 uF on VCC), plus the same HF bypass on the SN74LVC125 VCC and the island LDO output.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_CRYSTAL_FREQ
declarations.basis: CH347 datasheet section 5.1 clock: 8 MHz crystal on XI/XO (KDS 1C208000BC0R, LCSC C57131).

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_CRYSTAL_LOAD
declarations.basis: The CH347 datasheet 5.1 '~22 pF' is boilerplate for a CL=20 pF crystal. The fitted 1C208000BC0R is cut for CL=12 pF, so Cext = 2*(CL - Cstray) = 2*(12 - ~4) = 16 pF C0G per leg; 22 pF would over-load it and pull 8 MHz slow. LCSC C162205.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_RESET_PULL
declarations.basis: CH347 RST# (pin 1) already carries an internal pull-up and a built-in power-on reset (DS 5.1); the external 10k is noise-immunity insurance and no RC cap is fitted.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_MODE_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: CH347 DS section 5.2 mode table: MODE 3 (JTAG + UART) needs DTR1 (pin 10) and RTS1 (pin 13) both pulled LOW at power-on reset. Both pins carry built-in pull-ups of ~40 kohm, so a 10k external pulldown dominates.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_OE_PULLUP
declarations.basis: Default-OFF isolation: all four SN74LVC125 OE# pins are held HIGH (outputs Hi-Z) through 100k to the island rail until SW1 pulls them to GND, so a pod on the target JTAG header never contends with the bridge.

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_CONN_VBUS_BULK
declarations.basis: USB-C UFP VBUS bulk/bypass at the receptacle; the board-standard 0805 25 V part (LCSC C15850).

declarations.name: subsystems.JTAG_CONN_CC_RD
declarations.basis: USB Type-C specification device/UFP role: one Rd = 5.1 kohm +-20% per CC pin to GND, which tells a source to apply VBUS. LCSC C23186 is a 5% Basic part, inside the +-20% spec.

declarations.name: subsystems.USB_PD_VDD_BYPASS
declarations.basis: onsemi FUSB302B reference circuit: 100 nF HF on VDD.

declarations.name: subsystems.USB_PD_VDD_BULK
declarations.basis: FUSB302B reference circuit: 10 uF bulk companion on VDD.

declarations.name: subsystems.USB_PD_VBUS_BYPASS
declarations.basis: FUSB302B reference circuit: 100 nF on the VBUS-sense pin (U1.2), whose abs-max is 28 V.

declarations.name: subsystems.USB_PD_CC_FILTER
declarations.basis: FUSB302B reference circuit: 200 pF analog filter from each CC line to GND. NP0 0603 (LCSC C113796) so the BMC edge is not distorted by dielectric loss.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_CONN_VBUS_BULK
declarations.basis: USB-C UFP VBUS decoupling (Cbus) at the receptacle; the board-standard 0805 25 V part (LCSC C15850) against the 5.25 V worst-case rail.

declarations.name: subsystems.UART_CONN_CC_RD
declarations.basis: USB Type-C specification device/UFP role: one Rd = 5.1 kohm +-20% per CC pin; a source's Rp plus this Rd forms the attach divider. LCSC C23186 (0603WAF5101T5E, 5% Basic) is inside the spec tolerance.

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_INPUT_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TI TPS2051C input bypass at the switch IN pin.

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_VBUS_MLCC
declarations.basis: HF companion on the sourced VBUS. MLCC alone is not enough: at 5 V bias it derates to ~15-20 uF, below the USB 2.0 host-port 120 uF minimum and the TPS2051C datasheet 150 uF reference, so the bulk is carried by the electrolytic instead (more MLCC would only re-derate).

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_VBUS_BULK
declarations.basis: DMBJ RVT1C101M0605 100 uF 16 V aluminium electrolytic (LCSC C970684): its capacitance does NOT bias-derate, so it holds VBUS above 4.4 V through a device hot-plug. Pad 1 = +, pad 2 = -.

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_ENABLE_PULLDOWN
declarations.basis: TPS2051C EN is active-high; the pulldown holds the host VBUS switch OFF until the host drives VBUS_EN, so the port cannot source 5 V at power-on before the OTG role is decided.

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_FAULT_PULLUP
declarations.basis: TPS2051C FLT# is open-drain; the pull-up rails to +VDD_LOGIC so the flag stays inside the reader's IO abs-max and remains readable when the +VBUS_SUPPLY module rail is gated off.

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_CC_RP
declarations.basis: USB Type-C specification host/DFP role: Rp = 56 kohm +-20% per CC pin to VBUS advertises Default USB power. LCSC C23206 (0603WAF5602T5E, 1%).

declarations.name: subsystems.OTG_ID_STRAP
declarations.basis: OTG ID strapped to GND through 1 kohm = HOST role for this port; the series resistance limits current if a host drives the ID line.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.iset
declarations.basis: SY6280 current limit ILIM = 6800/13k = 523 mA, over the 200 mA QWIIC budget. LCSC C22797.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.en_pulldown
declarations.basis: Holds EN_AUX low so the gate is OFF at power-up until a human closes SW1 pos 1 (constraint C1). LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.decap
declarations.basis: SY6280 and PCA9306 per-pin bypass. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.in_reservoir
declarations.basis: SY6280 Rev.1.0E p.7 strongly recommends a 10uF ceramic VIN-to-GND supply filter for hot-plug droop and ringing. Nominal 10uF, 0805 25 V X5R, LCSC C15850; effective capacitance under DC bias is not established here.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.reference_filter
declarations.basis: TI SCPS113O 11.1 specifies a 100pF filter near VREF2. Samsung CL10C101JB8NNNC, 0603 50 V C0G +/-5%, LCSC C14858. This filter and its reference-current limiter do not qualify power-transition isolation.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.out_bulk
declarations.basis: Hold-up on the gated +3V3_AUX rail for the 200 mA QWIIC load. The SY6280 datasheet recommends an output cap and only the 100n was fitted (audit 2026-06-19); its soft-start tolerates 10u. 0805 25 V, LCSC C15850.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.led_ballast
declarations.basis: KT-0603R status LED ballast, ~3.9 mA from +3V3_AUX. LCSC C23138.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.iso_en_pullup
declarations.basis: R4 limits the PCA9306 VREF2 reference current from +3V3_AUX; EN directly follows AUX in switch mode. TI SCPS113O 8.1.5/8.1.8 permits separate enable control and lower reference resistance than 200k with increased bias current. Retained 100k C25803. Startup, shutdown and reverse rail isolation remain unqualified.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.bus_pullup
declarations.basis: AUX-side I2C pulls to the gated rail; the PCA9306 requires pulls on BOTH sides. LCSC C23162.

declarations.name: carrier.board_aux.i2c_speed
declarations.basis: Fast-mode on both sides of the isolator.

declarations.name: carrier.board_qwiic.i2c_speed
declarations.basis: Fast-mode AUX_I2C.

declarations.name: carrier.board_qwiic.clamp_bypass
declarations.basis: ST USBLC6-2 datasheet Rev 2 (June 2005), section 3 'How to ensure a good ESD protection', figure 7: a 100 nF capacitor close to the device between VBUS (pin 5) and ground holds the clamp reference constant during a positive surge. 0603 50 V X7R, LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.board_services.i2c_speed
declarations.basis: Fast-mode AUX_I2C, the PCA9306-isolated segment of STM32_I2C2.

declarations.name: carrier.board_services.decap
declarations.basis: Per-IC supply bypass. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.board_services.int_pullup
declarations.basis: RV-3028 open-drain alarm pull to the gated rail. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: carrier.board_services.backup_pulldown
declarations.basis: Ties the RV-3028 VBACKUP pin to VSS through jumper J1 while no cell is fitted: Micro Crystal RV-3028-C7 application manual Rev 1.0, pin description and section 4.2.1, state that an unused VBACKUP must be tied to VSS with a 10 kOhm resistor. J1 is opened before a cell is fitted. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: carrier.board_services.wdi_series_r
declarations.basis: Limits ESD back-feed into U3.WDI while +3V3_AUX is off but the PL still drives. It does NOT divide the kick: the LVCMOS33 driver VOH ~3.0 V clears the TPS3823 VIH = 0.7*VDD = 2.31 V, which the previous LVCMOS25 driver (VOH ~2.1 V) could not reliably meet. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en.dip_pulldown
declarations.basis: A-input pulldown, so an OPEN DIP reads 0 and a closed DIP reads 1. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en.override_pullup
declarations.basis: B-input pull to +3V3_SC, so a Hi-Z override source means ENABLED. That is what lets a blank system controller boot 'switches only'. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en.gate_decap
declarations.basis: One bypass per gate on +3V3_SC. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en_modules.dip_pulldown
declarations.basis: A-input pulldown, so an OPEN DIP reads 0 and a closed DIP reads 1. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en_modules.override_pullup
declarations.basis: B-input pull to +3V3_SC so a Hi-Z TCA9535 port means ENABLED. The LCD_BL cell is the ONE exception: P10 carries a 100k pullDOWN on bringup_rails instead, so that provision defaults OFF until software raises it.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_en_modules.gate_decap
declarations.basis: One bypass per gate on +3V3_SC. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.iset_523ma
declarations.basis: SY6280 ILIM = 6800/RSET, so 13k -> 523 mA for the lighter module rails. LCSC C22797.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.iset_1a
declarations.basis: SY6280 ILIM = 6800/RSET, so 6.8k -> 1.0 A for the heavier rails (LCD, SD, USB, LCD_5V). LCSC C23212.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.led_r_3v3

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.led_r_5v
declarations.basis: Status LED on a 5 V gated rail: (5-2)/1k = 3 mA (dossier 3.3). LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.in_reservoir

Every gated module rail is hot-pluggable. Nominal 10uF, 0805 25 V X5R, LCSC C15850; effective capacitance under DC bias is not established here.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.out_reservoir
declarations.basis: Silergy SY6280/A application note Rev1.0C: p.2 pin table, OUT (pin 1) 'decoupled with a 10uF capacitor to GND'; the p.4 electrical characteristics are specified at COUT = 10uF. Fitted on the four gated rails whose nets carry less than 10uF nominal in total across the board (+3V3_HDMI_RX 0.1uF, +5V_USB 0.2uF, +3V3_USER_LED 0.2uF, +5V_HDMI_TX 0.2uF); the other six rails already carry at least 10uF and keep the 100nF bypass. Nominal 10uF, 0805 25 V X5R, LCSC C15850; effective capacitance under DC bias is not established here.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.switch_decap
declarations.basis: Local HF bypass on each SY6280 OUT whose gated rail already carries at least 10uF nominal on the net from the module sheets (dossier 3.2 wiring note). LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_modules.sd_bleed
declarations.basis: ONLY the SD rail gets this. A microSD power-cycle re-init needs VDD below ~0.5 V. declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.i2c_speed
declarations.basis: Fast-mode STM32_I2C2.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.bus_pullup
declarations.basis: The STM32_I2C2 pull-ups live ONCE, here, on +3V3_SC — dossier risk R1: the bus must be alive before any carrier rail exists, because PD negotiation precedes them all. LCSC C23162.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.int_pullup

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.spare_pulldown

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.button_pullup
declarations.basis: Active-LOW PL buttons pulled to +3V3, the bank VCCO of those PL pins. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.debounce_cap
declarations.basis: RC debounce across the tact contacts. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.expander_decap
declarations.basis: TCA9535 VCC bypass. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.bringup_rails.pudc_strap
declarations.basis: IO_L3P_PUDC_34 has NO resistor on the SoM. PUDC LOW during config ENABLES the internal pull-ups (UG470), which suits the LCD 'DISP defaults on' 10k and the active-low PL buttons. declarations.name: carrier.debug_boot.bootsel_pullup
declarations.basis: Defined-high pull for the BOOTSEL request straps and the spare; closing the DIP pulls the line to GND. SC firmware decodes these and drives the on-module Zynq BMODE pins. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: carrier.fmc.pair_impedance

declarations.name: carrier.fmc.rail_bulk

declarations.name: carrier.fmc.rail_hf

declarations.name: carrier.fmc.ldo_out

declarations.name: carrier.hdmi_rx_term.term

declarations.name: carrier.hdmi_rx_term.avcc_hf

declarations.name: carrier.hdmi_rx_term.avcc_reservoir
declarations.basis: Charge reservoir for the 64 mA termination load swinging against AVCC, 50 V X5R. LCSC C15849. On this IC-less sheet both caps anchor as rail-decoupling columns, not an IC cluster.

declarations.name: carrier.motor_pwm.oe_pullup
declarations.basis: FAIL-SAFE ARM: holds #OE high so the buffer outputs stay HiZ and emit no spurious ESC pulses until the PL explicitly drives #OE low. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: carrier.motor_pwm.servo_iset

declarations.name: carrier.motor_pwm.in_reservoir

declarations.name: carrier.motor_pwm.switch_decap
declarations.basis: HCT245 VCC bypass at U1. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: carrier.motor_pwm.servo_holdup

declarations.name: carrier.motor_sense.shunt

declarations.name: carrier.motor_sense.rail_hf

declarations.name: carrier.motor_sense.supply_hf

declarations.name: carrier.motor_sense.supply_bulk

declarations.name: carrier.motor_sense.fault_pullup

declarations.name: carrier.power_mon.shunt_3a
declarations.basis: Series shunt on the 3 A rails (+VIN, +5V, +3V3), sized from the PLAN rail budgets: 30 mV at 3 A, 4 mA LSB. Part RLM12FTCMR010, 1206.

declarations.name: carrier.power_mon.shunt_600ma

declarations.basis: Charge reservoir at the DF40 power-pin entry, 25 V X5R 0805 (LCSC C45783), reusing a carrier-stocked ratings-verified MLCC.

declarations.name: devkit_mini.som_decoupling.hf
declarations.basis: High-frequency bypass at the DF40 power-pin entry, 50 V X7R 0603 (LCSC C14663).

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RAIL_HF
declarations.basis: HF bypass on the ESC rail at each XT60 and at the protection controller input (TI SNOSDF6 8.2.2.3: minimum 0.1 uF input and output). 100 V X7R Samsung CL10B104KC8NNNC, LCSC C15725: the part rule needs 2.0 x 25.2 V = 50.4 V. Samsung's published DC-bias data for this part (25 C, 1 kHz) gives -27.1 % at 25 V.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_CP_CAP
declarations.basis: Charge-pump capacitor CAP to VS. TI SNOSDF6 8.2.2.2: at least 0.1 uF and at least 10 x (Ciss Q1 + Ciss Q2) = 10 x 2 x 21.28 nF max (Infineon IPT007N06N Rev 2.1, dynamic characteristics) = 0.43 uF. CAP to VS is at most 14.1 V. LCSC C15849 (50 V).

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_DVDT_R
declarations.basis: Series resistor of the dV/dt capacitor, as in TI SNOSDF6 Figure 8-1 (RG 100 ohm); it speeds turn-off. LCSC C22775.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_DVDT_C
declarations.basis: HGATE dV/dt capacitor. TI SNOSDF6 equation 2: CdVdT = COUT x 55 uA / Iinrush. Gate slew 55 uA / 1 uF = 55 V/s: the rail rises to 25.2 V in 0.46 s; charging current is 0.052 A into the board's 940 uF and 0.33 A with a further 5000 uF of ESC capacitance. 100 V X7R 1206, CCTC TCC1206X7R105K101HT, LCSC C282823: the capacitor sees up to 25.2 V + 14.5 V gate drive.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RSET
declarations.basis: RSET between the sense node and CS+; TI SNOSDF6 8.2.2.5 recommends 50 to 100 ohm. LCSC C114625.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RISCP
declarations.basis: Short-circuit threshold shift: 20 mV + 4.7 k x 11 uA = 71.7 mV (TI SNOSDF6 equation 6), 143 A across the 0.5 mOhm shunt, HGATE off within 3 us. LCSC C23162.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RILIM
declarations.basis: Circuit-breaker threshold: I = 12 x RSET / (RILIM x RSENSE) = 12 x 49.9 / (15 k x 0.5 mOhm) = 79.8 A (TI SNOSDF6 equation 3), above the 60 A peak. LCSC C22809.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_TMR
declarations.basis: Circuit-breaker delay: T = 1.2 V x CTMR / 82.3 uA = 14.6 ms (TI SNOSDF6 equation 4). LCSC C15849.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RIMON
declarations.basis: Current-monitor load: VIMON = 0.9 x VSENSE x RIMON / RSET (TI SNOSDF6 equation 7) = 2.54 V at 60 A, 1.27 V at 30 A. LCSC C23162.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_ANALOG_SERIES
declarations.basis: Series resistor of each analogue output to a module pin: with the bank unpowered it limits the clamp current to 0.34 mA against the 10 mA limit (AMD DS187 v1.21 Table 2, IIN). LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_FLT_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the open-drain FLT output of the protection controller to the monitor supply. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_EN_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-down of EN: the ESC rail stays off (shutdown below 0.41 V, on above 1.05 V, TI SNOSDF6 6.5) until the enable line is driven high. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_VSENSE_TOP
declarations.basis: Battery-voltage divider for an ADC pin: 25.2 V x 10 k / 110 k = 2.29 V; 0.23 mA. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_VSENSE_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: Divider bottom, see ESC_POWER_VSENSE_TOP. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_VSENSE_FILTER
declarations.basis: Divider filter, 9.1 k x 100 nF = 0.9 ms. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_SHUNT
declarations.basis: In-line high-side shunt shared by the monitor and the protection controller. TA-I RLM25, 0.5 mOhm, 3 W to 70 C, 1 %, +/-75 ppm/C (TA-I TRLM-256Z001A, 2019/01/22, section 4), LCSC C710260. 30 A: 15 mV, 0.45 W. 60 A: 30 mV, 1.8 W. INA237 ADCRANGE = 1 full scale 40.96 mV (TI SBOSA20A 6.5) = 81.9 A.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_MON_BYPASS
declarations.basis: INA237 VS bypass; TI SBOSA20A 10.1 gives 0.1 uF as the typical value. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_ALERT_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the open-drain ALERT output (TI SBOSA20A Table 5-1) to the monitor supply. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_RAIL_BULK
declarations.basis: Load-side reservoir, two in parallel. ROQANG RVT 470 uF 50 V, 105 C 2000 h (ROQANG RVT series sheet), LCSC C90272: the part rule needs 1.5 x 25.2 V = 37.8 V. The series table gives 493 mA rms (12 x 13) to 550 mA rms (12.5 x 16) at 120 Hz for 470 uF 50 V; these cans are not sized to carry ESC ripple current, which the ESCs' own capacitors carry.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_STAR_TIE
declarations.basis: The single galvanic tie between GND_PWR (motor return) and GND (logic), at the inlet negative pin. Same 0.5 mOhm 3 W part as the shunt (77 A by its power rating): it carries the logic supply return, up to 2.8 A on battery, 1.4 mV drop. A UNI-ROYAL 0 ohm chip jumper is rated 1 A (0603) or 2 A (1206, 2512) with 10 A overload (UNI-ROYAL thick-film chip resistor datasheet, jumper table). The drop across TP3/TP4 measures the ground current.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_LIVE_LED_R
declarations.basis: Rail-live LED and bleeder, two in series: (25.2 V - 1.8 V) / 10.2 k = 2.3 mA (KENTO KT-0603R VF 1.8 to 2.4 V), 27 mW each. Discharges 940 uF with a 9.6 s time constant. LCSC C23186.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_POWER_I2C_SPEED
declarations.basis: Fast-mode management bus.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_IN_DAMP
declarations.basis: Aluminium capacitor in parallel with the ceramic input capacitors: TI SNVSBD5D 9.2.2.5 asks for one when long leads feed the converter, to damp input ringing. ROQANG RVT 470 uF 50 V, LCSC C90272 (1.5 x 25.2 V = 37.8 V needed). The eFuse ramp of 1.06 V/ms charges it at 0.5 A.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_UVLO_TOP
declarations.basis: UVLO/OVP divider top. With R2 = 10k and R3 = 5.1k: UVLO rising = 1.2 V x 115.1k / 15.1k = 9.15 V (falling 1.122 V -> 8.55 V), OVP cut-off rising = 1.2 V x 115.1k / 5.1k = 27.08 V (TI SLVSE94G 6.5, V(UVLOR), V(OVPR) = 1.2 V). 9.15 V is 3.05 V per cell on 3S; 27.08 V is 1.9 V above a full 6S pack. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_UVLO_MID
declarations.basis: UVLO/OVP divider middle, see VBAT_SUPPLY_UVLO_TOP. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_OVP_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: UVLO/OVP divider bottom, see VBAT_SUPPLY_UVLO_TOP. LCSC C23186.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_ILIM
declarations.basis: Current limit I(OL) = 18 / R(kohm) = 3.28 A (TI SLVSE94G 6.5: 9 k -> 2 A, 3 k -> 6 A; allowed 3 k to 30 k). Worst input current, every limited output at its limit, is 25.5 W / 9.15 V = 2.79 A; typical 17.8 W / 9.15 V = 1.95 A. LCSC C188263.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_DVDT
declarations.basis: Output ramp: 2 uA x 25 / 47 nF = 1.06 V/ms (TI SLVSE94G 6.5 I(dVdT), GAIN(dVdT)); 25.2 V in 24 ms, inrush into 9.6 uF about 10 mA. Same value as pd_input. LCSC C1622.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_FLT_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the open-drain FLT output to the logic rail, as pd_input. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_HV_HF
declarations.basis: HF bypass on the battery-voltage nets (eFuse input, buck VIN1/VIN2). 100 V X7R, LCSC C15725: 2.0 x 25.2 V = 50.4 V needed.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_BUCK_IN_BULK
declarations.basis: LM61460 input bulk behind the eFuse, two 4.7 uF 100 V X7R 1210 (CCTC TCC1210X7R475K101MT, LCSC C49451356). Effective capacitance under 25 V bias is not established here.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_VCC_BYPASS
declarations.basis: LM61460 VCC bypass, as power_som C22. LCSC C15849.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_BIAS_SERIES
declarations.basis: BIAS feed filter from the 8 V output, as power_som R17; BIAS maximum is 16 V (TI SNVSBD5D 7.1). LCSC C22859.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_BIAS_BYPASS
declarations.basis: BIAS bypass, as power_som C23. LCSC C15849.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_RT
declarations.basis: RT = 22 k sets fSW = 1 / (22 / 13460 + 3.3e-5) = 600 kHz (TI SNVSBD5D equation 2), as power_som. LCSC C31850.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_BOOT
declarations.basis: Bootstrap capacitor CBOOT to SW, as power_som C17. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_INDUCTOR
declarations.basis: 10 uH, Isat 4.1 A (LCSC C37429). Ripple at 25.2 V in, 8 V out, 600 kHz: 8 x (1 - 8/25.2) / (10 uH x 600 kHz) = 0.91 A p-p; peak at the worst 2.72 A load 3.18 A.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_OUT_BULK
declarations.basis: Output capacitors, 22 uF 25 V X5R as power_som (LCSC C45783); 2.0 x 8 V = 16 V needed.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_FB_TOP
declarations.basis: Feedback top: 1.0 V x (1 + 47.5k / 6.8k) = 7.985 V against the 8.0 V target (-0.2 %). LCSC C23061.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_FB_BOTTOM
declarations.basis: Feedback bottom, see VBAT_SUPPLY_FB_TOP. LCSC C23212.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_FF_CAP
declarations.basis: Feed-forward capacitor, as power_som C21. LCSC C1653.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_FF_SERIES
declarations.basis: Feed-forward series resistor, as power_som R19. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.VBAT_SUPPLY_PG_LED_R
declarations.basis: Pre-regulator present LED: (7.985 V - 1.9 V) / 1 k = 6.1 mA, 37 mW in the resistor. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_DRIVER_BYPASS
declarations.basis: HCT245 VCC bypass, as motor_pwm C1. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_OE_PULLUP
declarations.basis: Fail-safe: holds the driver #OE high (outputs high-impedance) until the PL drives it low through the closed ARM switch. As motor_pwm R1. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_SERVO_ISET
declarations.basis: SY6280 ILIM = 6800 / 13k = 523 mA on the servo power row, as motor_pwm R2. LCSC C22797.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_SERVO_IN
declarations.basis: SY6280 input capacitor, as motor_pwm C2. LCSC C15850.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_SERVO_OUT
declarations.basis: SY6280 output capacitor on the servo row, as motor_pwm C3. LCSC C15850.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_SERVO_EN_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-down of the servo-row switch enable: the row is off unless SW1 position 2 is closed. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_RX_BYPASS
declarations.basis: One bypass per 3.3 V receiver or gate. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_IDLE_BIAS
declarations.basis: Idle bias of each ESC line to the ESC_BIAS node: low (pull-down, default) for PWM and DShot, high for bidirectional DShot, whose line idles high while the driver is released. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_IDLE_SEL_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-down of the idle-select input, so an unconfigured PL leaves the lines biased low. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_TLM_SERIES
declarations.basis: Series limit between the telemetry connector and the receiver gate. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_TLM_PULL
declarations.basis: Idle-high pull of the ESC telemetry UART line (wire-ORed ESC transmitters). LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_LIVE_LED_R
declarations.basis: Outputs-enabled LED from +5V to the driver #OE node: lit only while #OE is low. (5 V - 2.6..3.1 V) / 1 k = 1.9 to 2.4 mA (KENTO KT-0603B VF 2.6 to 3.1 V at 5 mA); with #OE high at 3.3 V or 5 V the 1.7 V or 0 V across it is below VF. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.ESC_IO_OE_SENSE_SERIES
declarations.basis: Series resistor of the #OE read-back: the node is pulled to 5 V and is read by a 3.3 V expander. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.CAN_BUS_BYPASS
declarations.basis: One bypass at each transceiver supply pin, VCC (5 V) and VIO (3.3 V). LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.CAN_BUS_TXD_PULL
declarations.basis: Holds TXD high (recessive) while the PL pin is unconfigured. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.CAN_BUS_TERMINATION
declarations.basis: ISO 11898-2 bus termination, switched in by SW1 position 1 when this board is a bus end. 2 V dominant differential gives 33 mW. LCSC C22787.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_BYPASS
declarations.basis: TCA9535 VCC bypass. LCSC C14663.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_I2C_PULL
declarations.basis: Management-bus pull-ups, the only pair on the bus on a board that uses this sheet. NXP UM10204 Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 x Cb): 4k7 holds Fast-mode 300 ns for Cb <= 75 pF. LCSC C23162.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_INT_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the open-drain INT output. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_DIP_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-down of the user DIP position read on P10. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_LED_R
declarations.basis: User LED series resistor, sunk by an expander port: (3.3 V - 2.0 V) / 1 k = 1.3 mA. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_BTN_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the user button read on P13. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_PUDC_PULL
declarations.basis: PUDC_B strap to the bank rail: pull-ups off during configuration, so every PL pin is defined by the board's own pulls. 1 k is the largest value the FPGA vendor allows for this strap (Xilinx UG470; not re-opened for this draft). LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_REQ_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-down of the ESC power request (expander P14): the ESC rail is off until software drives the port high. LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_FAN_ISET
declarations.basis: SY6280 ILIM = 6800 / 13 k = 523 mA on the fan supply pin (Silergy AN_SY6280 Rev 0.1: Ilim (A) = 6800 / Rset (ohm)). LCSC C22797.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_FAN_IN
declarations.basis: SY6280 input capacitor, as esc_io C2. LCSC C15850.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_FAN_OUT
declarations.basis: SY6280 output capacitor at the fan connector. LCSC C15850.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_FAN_GATE_PULL
declarations.basis: Gate pull-down of the open-drain PWM driver: the fan PWM wire is released (fan at full speed) while the PL is unconfigured. AO3400A VGS(th) 0.65 to 1.45 V, RDS(on) < 48 mOhm at 2.5 V (AOS AO3400A Rev 3). LCSC C25803.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_TACH_PULL
declarations.basis: Pull-up of the fan's open-collector tachometer output. LCSC C25804.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_TACH_SERIES
declarations.basis: Series limit between the fan connector and the PL pin. LCSC C21190.

declarations.name: subsystems.BOARD_CONTROL_I2C_SPEED
declarations.basis: Fast-mode management bus.
